scope: Scoped agent inspection of five complete current exported mountain/river viewports. Every listed image was actually opened. Independent numerical checks, source-image production review, formal approval and physical-phone testing remain separate.
observations: The five complete current mountain/river frames were opened under the normal full HUD. Continuous relief shading remains beneath scenery, while the corrected Yanshan grass/soil covers the underlying terrain instead of the earlier broad orange leaf pattern.
Hankou and Nanjing retain connected source-channel ribbons, visible bank layering and their original model placements. The desktop X30-layout Hankou frame retains the same water/ground ordering.

Mountain-foot silhouettes still read as placed miniatures; ground/control polygons, repeated broad-area texture and near-city model crowding remain. These five frames are a scoped review and do not certify every map or commercial art parity.
remaining_visual_issues: Angular source headwaters and visible main-channel corners remain; bank widths are display symbols rather than measured historical widths.
Material/control polygons, repeated textures, miniature-like mountain feet, page boundaries and dense city/army overlap remain.
Complete historical/timeline review and physical Motorola X30 acceptance remain outstanding.
